description: This file defines the 'Library' class within the 'Thunder::Core' namespace, including its methods, nested iterator class, and related data structures for managing dynamic libraries across different platforms.

classes.name: Library
classes.description: Represents a dynamically loaded library, providing methods to load functions, check load status, and manage references.

classes.name: Library::Iterator
classes.description: Iterator class for enumerating loaded libraries or modules depending on platform.

methods.name: Library()
methods.description: Default constructor for the Library class.

methods.name: Library(const void* functionInLibrary)
methods.description: Constructor to load a library based on a function pointer.

methods.name: Library(const TCHAR fileName[])
methods.description: Constructor to load a library from a filename.

methods.name: IsLoaded()
methods.description: Checks if the library is currently loaded.

methods.name: WaitUnloaded()
methods.description: Waits for the library to unload with an optional timeout.

methods.name: Name()
methods.description: Returns the name of the loaded library.

methods.name: LoadFunction()
methods.description: Loads a function from the library by name.

methods.name: AddRef()
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the library.

methods.name: Release()
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and unloads if zero.
